log: ENERGY LEVELS IN EACH SPHERE -- NEXUS's real physics on FFT poses, which it has never seen
Geometry and learned embeddings both measured ~0 on these pose sets. The physics engine was
never applied to them. It also answers a question the NEXUS ledger left open: vdW ranked native
first 7/10 vs 6% chance against RANDOM-ROTATION decoys, and whether that survives HARD decoys
was recorded as untested. FFT poses are the hard decoys.
PREDECLARED: an energy arm beating shape on Spearman without losing top-100 or enrichment => the
physics ranks poses. energy ~ shape => adds nothing. energy fails => the 70% was easy negatives,
which corrects a headline NEXUS result. Sign fixed before the run: working arm has NEGATIVE rho.
